# B-E Waterwell Services

> Family-owned water well drilling and service company serving the greater Houston, Texas area since 1979. TDLR licensed. Based in Magnolia, TX. More than 5,000 wells serviced across Montgomery, Harris, Waller, Grimes, Washington, Anderson, and surrounding counties. Phone: (281) 448-4447. Hours: Mon–Fri 7am–7pm. Emergency service available.

B-E Waterwell Services provides complete water well solutions: new well drilling and installation, residential well services, commercial and agricultural wells, well rehabilitation, and well maintenance and inspection. All work is performed by TDLR-licensed technicians. B-E Waterwell is a Franklin Electric authorized dealer for pumps and motors.

## Services

- [Water Well Services (overview)](https://bewaterwells.com/services): All five service categories from one company.
- [Water Well Drilling & Installation](https://bewaterwells.com/services/water-well-drilling): New residential, irrigation, and commercial well drilling and full installation.
- [Residential Well Services](https://bewaterwells.com/services/residential): Pump repair and replacement, pressure tanks, constant pressure systems, generator prep, and emergency service.
- [Commercial & Agricultural Wells](https://bewaterwells.com/services/commercial): High-capacity wells for ranches, farms, equestrian properties, nurseries, and commercial sites.
- [Well Rehabilitation](https://bewaterwells.com/services/well-rehabilitation): Restore yield and water quality through mechanical jetting, shock chlorination, and acid treatment.
- [Well Maintenance & Inspection](https://bewaterwells.com/services/well-maintenance): Annual inspection, real-estate and FHA/VA well inspections, and ongoing maintenance programs.
